We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The facts: illegal profit by introducing others to issue false VAT special invoices (增值税专用发票) for a company, collecting fee. Also forged general machine printed invoices and VAT ordinary invoices. So crimes: 虚开增值税专用发票 (fictitious VAT special invoices) used to obtain tax deductions, also forging invoices (伪造发票). Possibly also 伪造、变造发票. In examples, they label "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". Here it's for tax deduction, not export. So label: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取抵扣税款发票; also 伪造发票. In earlier example with similar facts (first case) they gave: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". So we can use same: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票. But here no export, just deduction. Could still include both. Also forging invoices: 伪造、变造发票. In examples, they sometimes combine: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". So answer likely that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;伪造发票<eoa>
